source_policy: The Markdown guide/examples use original prose and pseudocode only. They do not require, embed, or redistribute FLUKA-distributed Fortran files.
user_guidance: If editing is required, use a user-provided .f file in the case/run workspace or a template copied by the user from their own licensed FLUKA installation.
manual_basis: Official FLUKA Manual PDF, 2024, plus version-specific verification against the user's installed FLUKA manual/release.
